rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Quiet riverside residential kerb; homes close on both sides.
reasons: Dead-end style street, little through traffic

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartment blocks line both sides, within about 10-25 m of the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; a van would fit in line with them.
drivers.traffic: Narrow local street with light traffic.
drivers.convention: Residential kerb parking, no sign of campervans or overnight stays.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Brisbane River 187 m away
sun_shade: Mixed street trees; flats on the river side shade the west kerb in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Griffith Street kerb just south of the pin, by the river-side flats
